pump.name: Centrifugal pump P-101
pump.d1: The pump shaft is not turning and there is no running noise.
pump.d2: Suction and discharge valves appear open from where you stand.
pump.d3: Equipment that is not running has not necessarily been made safe for maintenance.

motor.d1: Motor is silent. The cooling fan is not turning.
motor.d2: The motor could be started remotely unless its energy sources are verified isolated.

statusPanel.name: Equipment status panel

safetyBoard.name: Safety information board
safetyBoard.d1: Training principle: stopped is not the same as safe.
safetyBoard.d2: Before maintenance, verification evidence must be complete and documented.
safetyBoard.d3: If evidence is missing — stop, do not proceed, and report it.

silentPump.title: The Silent Pump
silentPump.subtitle: Pre-Maintenance Hazard Recognition
silentPump.description: Pump P-101 is not running and is scheduled for maintenance. Decide whether the work can safely proceed.

briefing.1: Supervisor (simulated): "Morning. P-101 is down and the seal job is on your list today."
briefing.2: "Operations stopped the pump earlier. Check the area, the status panel and the paperwork before anyone touches it."
briefing.3: "Your call: can the maintenance task proceed or not? Record your decision at the checklist station."

objectives.1: Recognise that stopped equipment is not automatically verified safe for maintenance.
objectives.2: Find and compare the available verification evidence.
objectives.3: Make and record a go / no-go decision based on evidence.

step.pipReview: Corrective practice: review the safety information board
step.correctiveReview: Re-check the isolation evidence in the documents

instruction.briefing: Read the briefing and acknowledge it.
instruction.enter: Walk north along the walkway into the barriered pump workstation.
instruction.locatePump: Find pump P-101 on the plinth and press E while looking at it.
instruction.inspectStatus: Read the status panel next to the pump.
instruction.inspectDocs: Read the work documentation at the permit desk near the entrance.
instruction.pipReview: Review the safety information board at the workstation entrance.
instruction.reviewChecklist: Open the pre-maintenance checklist station beside the permit desk.
instruction.identifyGap: At the station, flag the evidence item that is incomplete.
instruction.correctiveReview: Read the work documentation again and confirm what is missing.
instruction.decision: Record your decision at the checklist station.

hint.briefing: Use the Acknowledge button at the bottom of the briefing.
hint.enter: Follow the yellow walkway north to the gap in the barriers.
hint.locatePump: The pump is the blue casing on the concrete plinth, coupled to the grey motor.

inspectStatus.1: Look for the panel with a screen and an amber lamp on top.
inspectStatus.2: Notice the difference between run status and isolation status.

inspectDocs.1: The documents are on the desk under the shelter by the entrance.
inspectDocs.2: Check every signature field, not just the work order.

hint.pipReview: The board is on the left of the workstation entrance.
hint.reviewChecklist: The checklist station is the board to the right of the permit desk.

identifyGap.1: Which evidence did you see in the documents that was not signed?
identifyGap.2: The status panel also said something was not confirmed.
identifyGap.3: Flag the energy isolation verification record.

hint.correctiveReview: Read the documents again — look at the isolation verification signature.
hint.decision: With verification evidence missing, can work safely begin?

decision.noGo: Do not proceed — report missing verification

feedback.decideWithoutEvidence: Identify the specific missing evidence before making the decision.
feedback.wrongEvidence: That item is complete in the documents. Compare again.

go.explanation: Proceeding because the pump looks stopped is unsafe. A stopped pump has not been verified safe for maintenance.

spanner.explanation: Starting physical work before verification evidence is complete is unsafe.

critical.missing: Missing: a completed energy isolation verification record. Until it is complete, the task must not proceed.

debrief.success: Correct decision. The pump was stopped, but the isolation verification record was not signed. Stopped is not the same as verified safe — you stopped the job and reported the gap.
debrief.critical: You reached the correct decision, but only after an unsafe action. In this training scenario, proceeding without verification evidence is a critical error.
debrief.failed: The attempt ended after repeated unsafe actions. Review the concepts below and try again.

how.1: Read the briefing, then explore the training area.
how.2: Objects highlight when you are close enough and looking at them.
how.3: Your checklist ticks itself from verified actions only.

about.title: About OpenIndustri-AI
about.body: OpenIndustri-AI is an interactive 3D industrial safety simulation and gaming platform for Industry 5.0 human-centric workforce training. It runs fully locally in your browser with a local training server.
about.body2: Missions use provisional educational rule sets that require approval by qualified safety experts. The 3D environment is a conceptual simulation, not a validated engineering digital twin.
about.credits: Built with Babylon.js, TypeScript, Vite, i18next, FastAPI and SQLite. All 3D geometry and sounds are generated procedurally by this application. Fonts: Noto Sans Tamil and Noto Sans Devanagari (SIL Open Font License).
